<subject>Catherine Storey for Corporate Advisory Cutoff Procedures</subject>
<body>
I spoke with each of you a couple of weeks ago, and this matter was set aside due to other urgent priorities. However, you all agreed that establishing a standard cutoff for finalising corporate advisory submissions would be beneficial.

The preferred approach is to set the cutoff at 4pm each day (to give a sense of volume, I reviewed yesterday’s activity to see how many transactions were finalised after 4pm London time. We had three UK corporate filings, and two cross-border advisory mandates). Any submissions after 4pm would automatically roll over to the following business day. For those transactions that don’t roll forward after 4pm, the various practice groups will need to remember these fall under the next day’s workload. 

I’m not sure how the Compliance team’s reporting processes would need adjustment, as the official records won’t reflect these late transactions. Could Compliance generate supplemental daily reports to ensure desks have accurate positions each morning?

Please share any feedback you may have, and in any case, please confirm that a 4pm cutoff suits your respective teams.

Danielle  
x36557

Eric – any concerns regarding the new reporting protocol?  
Mary – we touched on this briefly a few weeks ago… any further thoughts?
</body>
